title: Kiểm tra tuần 3: Kế hoạch, khả năng và so sánh
passage: Nam is a university student in Ho Chi Minh City. He usually studies at the library after class because it is quieter than his room. Next month, he is going to travel to Da Lat with two friends. They are going to take the night bus because it is cheaper than the plane. Da Lat is smaller than Ho Chi Minh City, but it is much cooler. In fact, it is one of the coolest cities in Vietnam. Nam can't speak much English, so he wants to practise with tourists there. His friend Linh can speak English very well, and she will help him. Nam thinks the trip will be the best holiday of the year.

questions.q: We have bought the tickets. We ___ visit Da Lat next week.
questions.explain: Kế hoạch đã định dùng be going to + V: are going to visit.

questions.q: It was raining, ___ we stayed at home.
questions.explain: Vế sau là kết quả của vế trước nên dùng so.

questions.q: My grandmother is 80, but she ___ still ride a bike.
questions.explain: can + động từ nguyên mẫu, không thêm -s và không có to.

questions.q: When I was five, I ___ swim, but now I swim very well.
questions.explain: Không có khả năng trong quá khứ dùng couldn't.

questions.q: Travelling by plane is ___ than travelling by bus.
questions.explain: Tính từ dài so sánh hơn dùng more + adj + than.

questions.q: Today is ___ day of the year.
questions.explain: So sánh nhất của tính từ ngắn: the + adj-est → the hottest.

options: She is always late for class.
She always is late for class.
Always she is late for class.
She is late always for class.
questions.explain: Trạng từ tần suất đứng sau động từ to be: is always.

questions.q: ___ do you go to work? – By bus.
questions.explain: Hỏi về phương tiện/cách thức dùng How.
passport = hộ chiếu; luggage = hành lý; passenger = hành khách.

questions.q: It is ___ outside, so take your raincoat.
questions.explain: Mang áo mưa vì trời mưa (rainy).
colleague = đồng nghiệp; customer = khách hàng; salary = tiền lương.

questions.q: We stayed in a ___ near the beach for three nights.
questions.explain: Nơi ở lại qua đêm khi đi du lịch là hotel (khách sạn).

questions.q: Why are Nam and his friends going to take the night bus?
options: It is faster than the plane.
It is more comfortable than the plane.
It is cheaper than the plane.
questions.explain: Bài đọc viết: 'because it is cheaper than the plane'.

questions.q: In the passage, the word 'cooler' means:
questions.explain: Ở đây cooler nói về thời tiết: mát hơn, tức là ít nóng hơn.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Nam's plan for a trip to Da Lat
questions.explain: Phần lớn bài đọc nói về chuyến đi Đà Lạt sắp tới của Nam.
